claims.claim: ShopeeSourceExtractor now expands only from a unique identity-matched positive product anchor to the nearest bounded variant scope, failing closed for absent or ambiguous roots without adding broader authorities or global option scans.

Exact selection-box-selected/unselected button tokens share the existing deterministic all-or-nothing group contract; gallery masks, add-ons, incomplete selections, missing labels, identity mismatches, and ambiguous roots emit no selected-variant observations.

Accepted live-shaped state preserves exact group and option text and appends the unchanged TASK-172 variant ProductFact contract after the existing fact prefix, without changing readiness, media, identity, browser, or resolver behavior.
Lifecycle documentation records TASK-172 as published, TASK-173 as the current narrow P6.3b blocker hardening, P6.2 as parked and reopenable, and live certification as downstream.
The final committed implementation changes exactly the seven TASK-173-scoped files and has no unresolved implementation items.
